sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Mode name and text patterns
sections.what: Brings in the case input type and defines the fixed demo mode name, plus patterns for identifiers, demo-style words and sensitive-looking content.
sections.why: Likely reason: the rules live in one file so every entry point applies the same checks.
sections.watch_out: Editing a pattern changes what gets blocked everywhere it is used.

sections.name: isSyntheticIdentifier
sections.title: Identifier check
sections.what: Accepts an identifier only if it begins with DEMO followed by letters, digits or hyphens, ignoring surrounding spaces and letter case.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes made-up identifiers obvious at a glance.
sections.watch_out: A real identifier that happens to begin with DEMO would pass this check.

sections.name: isSyntheticDemoLabel
sections.title: Demo label check
sections.what: Accepts a label only if it is not empty, is at most 120 characters, contains a demo-style word in English or Hindi, avoids sensitive-looking patterns and contains no slashes.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops real names or numbers from being entered as labels.
sections.watch_out: The sensitive-looking pattern is a rough screen and does not catch all personal data.

sections.name: isValidSyntheticCaseInput
sections.title: Full case input check
sections.what: Checks a new case input: the khata number must pass, the khesra number must pass if one is given, and the district, circle, village and nickname labels must all pass.
sections.why: Likely reason: one gate for all case creation.
sections.watch_out: If a new field is added to case input, it must also be added here or it will not be checked.

sections.name: isApprovedSyntheticFixture
sections.title: Fixture lookup by identifier
sections.what: Finds a fixture by its identifier and returns it only if it is marked synthetic, otherwise returns nothing.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops non-synthetic entries from being used as demo fixtures.
sections.watch_out: A fixture missing the synthetic flag is treated as not found.

summary: Holds the single allowed demo mode and checks that case inputs look like synthetic demo data rather than real personal identifiers.
purpose: Protects the prototype from accepting real-looking identifiers or personal information.
why: Likely reason: the app is a prototype using made-up data, so a guard keeps real citizen data from being entered by mistake.
how: Sets the one supported mode name. Patterns require identifiers to begin with DEMO, labels to contain a demo-style word in English or Hindi, labels to be 120 characters or fewer, and labels to avoid sensitive-looking content and slashes. The isValidSyntheticCaseInput function checks the khata number, optional khesra number and the four labels. The isApprovedSyntheticFixture function returns a fixture only if its identifier matches and it is marked synthetic.
inputs: A case creation input, text values, or a list of fixtures.
outputs: True or false from the checks, or a matched fixture or nothing.
risks: Pattern checks are not complete privacy protection. A real value can pass if it contains a demo-style word, and a valid demo value could be refused if it lacks the right prefix.
debug: If a valid demo case is refused, check its label contains a demo-style word and no slash. If an identifier is refused, check it starts with DEMO.
